cat.name: Cube Pets: animal-cat
cat.author: Kenney
cat.notes: Node-animated (not skinned): each part is its own mesh, so procedural gait/tail/squash are plain node rotations. Eyes are UV-mapped palette cells on the flat front face of `body`; overlay face decals there. Material + colormap are shared by every clone: clone them before recoloring.

sitter.name: KayKit Adventurers: Rogue
sitter.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
sitter.notes: Skinned 41-joint rig. Weapons and cape removed. Bones handslotr / handslotl = spray bottle + scruff anchors. Single palette texture (rogue_texture): recolor skin/hair/shirt by repainting a canvas copy.

baguette.name: loaf-baguette
baguette.author: Kenney
baguette.notes: Long axis = Z. Sticks out of groceryBag tilted ~20 degrees.

groceryBag.name: bag
groceryBag.author: Kenney
groceryBag.notes: End show: owner B carries it in the hold anchor, the baguette sticks out of the top.

aquarium.name: Fish Tank
aquarium.author: Chris Ross
aquarium.notes: Glass is transparent (no shadow). Built-in fish are materials `mat18` + `mat13` (one mesh per color, not per fish): hide them and swim 3 `fish` clones (rotation reset) inside for tank.fish 0..3.

bed.name: Bed_King
bed.author: Quaternius
bed.notes: Raised in level.ts: only the Wood frame below 0.22 m stretches, the bedding moves up rigidly.

bookshelf.name: bookcaseOpen
bookshelf.author: Kenney
bookshelf.notes: Empty: fill with book / frame / plantPot props.

carrier.name: picnic_basket_square
carrier.author: Isa Lousberg (Tiny Treats)
carrier.notes: No free pet carrier exists; a lidded wicker basket (classic cat basket) stands in. Flip the two lid nodes for carrier.closed, wobble the root while a caged cat mashes.

catBed.name: Cat Bed
catBed.author: J-Toastie
catBed.notes: Decor: the expensive cat bed nobody sleeps in (no nav surface on purpose).

door.name: wall_tiled_doorway (door node only)
door.author: Isa Lousberg (Tiny Treats)
door.notes: Interior door leaf (frame is architecture). Hinge edge at x = -size[0]/2.

frontDoor.name: Door_8
frontDoor.author: Quaternius
frontDoor.notes: Door leaf only. Hinge edge at x = +size[0]/2.

laptop.name: Laptop
laptop.author: J-Toastie
laptop.notes: Screen material is `Screen` (near black): put the laptop.screen canvas texture on it or on a plane in front.

laundryBasket.name: basket_B
laundryBasket.author: Isa Lousberg (Tiny Treats)
laundryBasket.notes: Open wicker tub with handle holes: the laundry basket, a `towels` stack sits in it (laundry spot).

litterBox.name: Container Bag Open
litterBox.author: MilkAndBanana
litterBox.notes: Open plastic tray recolored to mint with sand-colored litter. Put poop models on the fill for litter.fill.

tv.name: Retro TV
tv.author: Alex Safayan
tv.notes: Tabletop CRT with antennas, screen faces +Z (source faced -Z, rotated). Screen is material `mat23` (near black, no UVs): put a UV-mapped plane with the Cat TV texture just in front of it.

fish.name: Fish
fish.author: Quaternius
fish.notes: Rotated onto its side for flopping: play the swim clip fast. Also good for tank fish (rotation [0,0,0]).

tp.name: TIME HOTEL Rock Forms 5 (White)
tp.author: S. Paul Michael
tp.notes: Crumpled white heap read as unrolled toilet paper.

sprayBottle.name: Spray Bottle
sprayBottle.author: J-Toastie
sprayBottle.notes: Sitter tool (not a PropKind). Nozzle points +X in source, rotated so it points +Z.

treatBag.name: flour_sack_closed
treatBag.author: Isa Lousberg (Tiny Treats)
treatBag.notes: Sitter tool (not a PropKind). Rolled-top sack with a blank label.
